fleet.note: E(lw1) ranking of all fleet plans (cpp checker, /tmp/gcv/rank.txt); per-color minima show every color class individually reaches a single cycle in-family

verdict: PASS everywhere: donation volume (R1/4.2), RF2 ribbon closure (RF1+RF2 verified on every rebuilt child), parity ledger (all nine signs -1 in every analyzed plan).

PASS everywhere (overturning the review S7 suspicion): base-circuit z-holonomy is NOT in the translation trap -- in all 10 leaf instances the first-return holonomy on the main circuit fiber is a NONLINEAR m^2-cycle (full 16-cycle on Z, displacement subgroup = all of (Z/m)^2).  The wild (z0,z1)-ingredient the review demands is already present and doing its job.

FAIL (shallow, 3/5 plans): spanning coverage -- mutation drift left exactly ONE x-fiber with zero donated x-reads; that fiber is invariant and contributes a tower of m=4 trapped z-translation 4-cycles (the [...,4,4,4,4] tails).  One extra in-family donation through the fiber removes the tower (coverage_patch_experiment) but back-reacts on the donor old color, so coverage must be guarded, not post-repaired.

FAIL (all plans, the real floor): SIMULTANEITY, not a leaf invariant.  No candidate chi(x,z) is preserved by any leaf return (no x-block system: cycles overlap heavily on fibers; no z-congruence mod 2 or 4; holonomy orbit partitions are not coset partitions; displacement groups are full).  Moreover cpp_rs1010 has nu1 a SINGLE m^8-cycle and cpp_rs5252 has an old color single, so no per-color in-family obstruction exists.  What never happens is all nine simultaneously: the donations that merge the leaf cycles back-react on the donor old colors (old ncyc 3..7 in every best plan), and the fleet floor E(lw1) (see the fleet block; it dropped 30 -> 24 while this diagnosis ran) is an annealing plateau of the coarse move class (whole-ribbon re-offsets move thousands of points per step), not a conserved quantity.

floor_mechanism.odd_counts: parity: every analyzed return has sign -1, so ncyc is odd; the ODDNESS of the floor sequence is the ledger, exactly as the review says.
floor_mechanism.magnitude: the >1 magnitude is NOT a holonomy orbit index of a preserved congruence: it is (a) one uncovered fiber (+m trapped cycles) when present, plus (b) 2-6 residual unmerged cycles with no separating invariant -- i.e. a search/move-granularity plateau.

proposed_ingredient: (i) coverage guard: keep a donated orbit through every x-fiber as a hard plan invariant (reject mutations that orphan a fiber).  The coverage_patch_experiment shows a single extra in-family donation through the orphaned fiber removes the trapped tower (e.g. cpp_f1078: nu1 7 -> 5 at unchanged E) but BACK-REACTS on the donor old color (c4 7 -> 9 there) -- guarding coverage during the anneal is cheaper than repairing it afterwards.

(ii) surgical merge moves: the family lacks any fine-grained RF2-closed exchange.  Every current move re-offsets a whole q-wound ribbon (>= 2m cells, m points each).  A minimal pair move -- exchange two donated staircase cells of the SAME donor orbit at two offsets (an L^{-1}D-closed 2-cell swap), or a one-column leaf stair conditioned on hitting two different leaf cycles -- acts as a near-transposition on one return and can merge the last 2-6 cycles without touching parity (pairs) or coverage.  Since NO preserved invariant separates the residual cycles, nothing obstructs such merges in principle.
(iii) donor-aware acceptance: weight old-color cycle counts with the same priority as leaves (the floor now sits in the old colors as much as the leaves).
synthesis.obstruction_candidate: NONE supportable: an in-family obstruction statement of the form "every plan preserves a chi(x,z) with >= k classes on a leaf" is FALSIFIED by cpp_rs1010 (nu1 single m^8-cycle, in-family, skipped=0, RF1/RF2 PASS).  If anything is to be proved, the correct target is the POSITIVE statement: the seam family already realizes every single-return requirement separately; what remains is a finite combinatorial assembly (all nine at once), for which the fine move class (ii) is the missing ingredient, not a new invariant-breaking layer piece.
